definition: The frameworks, policies, and institutional practices used to guide the responsible development, deployment, and oversight of AI systems.
details: AI governance spans organizational policy, industry standards, and government regulation, addressing concerns like safety, transparency, accountability, and the societal impacts of increasingly capable AI systems.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. Boil it down and it is this: The frameworks, policies, and institutional practices used to guide the responsible development, deployment, and oversight of AI systems. Here is why it matters: AI governance spans organizational policy, industry standards, and government regulation, addressing concerns like safety, transparency, accountability, and the societal impacts of increasingly capable AI systems. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is AI Governance.
